name: cody-codex-plugin
description: Connect Cody over the local network and inspect work across Codex chats. Cody Studio is always SIMULATED.

interface.shortDescription: Keep your Codex work in sight.
interface.longDescription: Connect Cody over your local network. Inspect observed Codex chats, turns and tool calls, with current and historical evidence distinguished. Receive updates and answer questions with two or three choices. Reply sent confirms receipt by Codex. Native approvals stay on your PC. Cody Studio is always SIMULATED and connects only when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Find Cody on my local network.
Connect Cody using the six-character code on its display.
Show Cody's connection and observed Codex work.
